start.description: Start date for the EvalMetrics call on {@link Sensor}

end.description: End date for the EvalMetrics call on {@link Sensor}

interval.description: Interval or granularity for the EvalMetrics call on {@link Sensor}

sensors.description:
Array of {@link Sensor}s to build the dataset. By default, `sensors` is populated with every
{@link Sensor}s which are below the {@link ReliabilityAsset} the method `detectAnomalousPeriod()` is
on in the hierarchy.  Filter of the fetch performed on {@link Sensor} is `currentReliabilityAssetSensorRelations.from==asset.id`

title:
Spec to build the dataset on which the anomaly detection method is going to be performed. The dataset is built
by calling the `evalMetrics()` method on {@link Sensor} with the metric `Quantity`.
name: ReliabilityAnomalousPeriodDetectionDataSourceSpec
